text:
emma: Quick Q — can I redeem banked holidays as PTO during the launch sprint next week? payroll cutoff is friday, and our team lead said there's a blackout that week. do i need manager approval or is people ops ok to process retro?

raj: Short answer: you can request redemption but blackout weeks block automated scheduling. Need manager approval + people-ops signoff before payroll cutoff to convert into pay/PTO.

mike: @emma pls file the Banked Time Redemption form and ping me. i can approve fast but if payroll cutoff passes we might have to wait until next cycle.

hr-bot: FYI policy: banked holidays may be converted to PTO up to 40 hours/year. conversions must be submitted at least 48 hours before payroll cutoff unless exception granted. Cannot auto-convert to sick. Link: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/banked-holidays

sarah: if someone gets sick during the blackout, can we change a scheduled redeemed PTO to sick retroactively?

raj: If it's a valid sick event (doctor's note if requested) we can reclassify after the fact but payroll adjustments need a case request to payroll@redwood.com. manager confirmation helps.

len: note on partial days: we accept fractional hour redemptions but the form must list exact hours and matching dates. payroll handles day-level flags so please coordinate early.

carla: also: during critical launch blackout we discourage non-essential PTO or conversions. exceptions ok for emergencies; we route those to ppl-ops escalation.

emma: thanks — filing now. form: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/forms/banked-time (fyi)

raj: quick checklist for you @emma:
- submit Banked Time Redemption form (link above)
- ask manager (mike) to approve in portal
- cc payroll@redwood.com if within 48h of cutoff
- if sick overlap, file incident in people-ops with manager note

mike: approved when i get the form. :thumbsup:

hr-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff this pay period is 1977505200 (unix timestamp).

emma: perfect — will do. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

carla: filing note for ops: track one potential exception if @emma needs retro conversion.

raj: got it. i'll monitor and escalate to payroll if needed.

emma: closing thread once payroll confirms.
